# Archived upstream workflows

These workflow files are retained for source reference only. GitHub Actions does
not execute files outside `.github/workflows/`.

The imported workflows included release and package publishing, Python package
publication, Mintlify preview deployment, preview artifact management, external
contributor handoff, and credentialed evaluations. They require upstream
infrastructure and were disabled before BrowseActra's first publication.

The active `.github/workflows/ci.yml` is the BrowseActra-owned validation
workflow. Restore archived automation only after reviewing its permissions,
secrets, destinations, and effects for this repository.
